records.caption: Realistic freestanding contemporary storage cabinet.
records.description: Realistic freestanding contemporary storage cabinet. Clear furniture construction with: - one main cabinet body - two front doors - two clearly visible door handles - several internal shelves visible when possible - four short support legs or a clearly defined base - realistic thickness for panels and doors Modern restaurant, dining room or home furniture style. Simple elegant design, realistic proportions and manufacturable construction. Medium detail with clearly separated structural components. Single complete cabinet, centered and isolated. No objects stored inside, no decorations on top, no room, no wall, no background scene. Avoid carved ornaments, excessive bevels and unnecessary small details. Game-ready realistic 3D asset.

records.caption: Realistic contemporary floor lamp with a clearly readable modular structure.
records.description: Realistic contemporary floor lamp with a clearly readable modular structure. The lamp must contain: - a stable circular or rectangular base - one long vertical stem - a clearly separated lampshade - a visible bulb or emitter element inside the shade - a few simple connection pieces between the stem and shade Elegant modern restaurant or interior design style. Realistic dimensions and manufacturable construction. Medium detail, clean geometry and clearly separated structural components. Single isolated floor lamp only. No table, no furniture, no room, no wall, no floor scene, no decorative clutter. Avoid extremely thin wires, excessive ornaments and floating pieces. Game-ready realistic 3D asset.
